svg.aria-label: How to make a Piña Colada, step by step: Combine ingredients. Add the rum, cream of coconut, pineapple juice and lime juice to your shaker. Shake. Add crushed ice and shake hard, until the cream of coconut is all mixed in. Pour it all in. Pour everything, ice and all, into a tall glass. Top it up with more crushed ice if it needs it. Garnish. A pineapple wedge and a cherry. Cheers!
